## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Escalation types whose table entry is REQUIRE_HUMAN always return...

The system SHALL ensure that escalation types whose table entry is REQUIRE_HUMAN always return REQUIRE_HUMAN regardless of the distribution, asserted per type by a parametrised test.

#### Scenario: Escalation types whose table entry is REQUIRE_HUMAN always return...

WHEN `route-recoverable-escalation-actions-on-confidence` is implemented
THEN Escalation types whose table entry is REQUIRE_HUMAN always return REQUIRE_HUMAN regardless of the distribution, asserted per type by a parametrised test.

### Requirement: The candidate action set passed for each type is a subset of that type's...

The system SHALL ensure that the candidate action set passed for each type is a subset of that type's table-permitted recoverable actions, asserted by a test over every escalation type.

#### Scenario: The candidate action set passed for each type is a subset of that type's...

WHEN `route-recoverable-escalation-actions-on-confidence` is implemented
THEN The candidate action set passed for each type is a subset of that type's table-permitted recoverable actions, asserted by a test over every escalation type.

### Requirement: Below act_floor the handler routes to the human intent rather than the...

The system SHALL ensure that below act_floor the handler routes to the human intent rather than the fallback action, covered by a test.

#### Scenario: Below act_floor the handler routes to the human intent rather than the...

WHEN `route-recoverable-escalation-actions-on-confidence` is implemented
THEN Below act_floor the handler routes to the human intent rather than the fallback action, covered by a test.

### Requirement: Every handled escalation records the chosen action, its distribution and...

The system SHALL ensure that every handled escalation records the chosen action, its distribution and degraded flag in the escalation record.

#### Scenario: Every handled escalation records the chosen action, its distribution and...

WHEN `route-recoverable-escalation-actions-on-confidence` is implemented
THEN Every handled escalation records the chosen action, its distribution and degraded flag in the escalation record.
